description:
I’m Agastya, an Engineering Admission Counsellor supporting students across Maharashtra in selecting the right engineering colleges and branches based on their exam performance and interests.
I help students clearly understand CAP rounds, cutoff trends, and option filling, so they can avoid common admission mistakes.
My guidance is practical, transparent, and student-first, focused on realistic outcomes.
My goal is to make engineering admissions smooth, clear, and stress-free for every student.
